recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（非形態圖）：第 16 號染色體中一條明顯變長，長臂多出一段帶紋物質，符合 t(1;16) 所形成的衍生 16 號染色體；性染色體為 XX。
features: G-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes and two X chromosomes (female)
One chromosome 16 homolog markedly elongated with additional banded material on the long arm
Extra material consistent with chromosome 1 derived segments, i.e. der(16)t(1;16)
Chromosome 1 homologs show no obvious reciprocal change at this resolution, suggesting an unbalanced rearrangement
describe_en: The figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. One chromosome 16 homolog is markedly elongated by additional banded material on its long arm, consistent with a derivative chromosome 16 resulting from a t(1;16) translocation, while the chromosome 1 pair shows no obvious reciprocal change at this resolution. Such an unbalanced der(16)t(1;16) results in gain of 1q material, a recurrent secondary abnormality in myeloid neoplasms. In the sister of the GATA2 proband with MDS progressing to AML, this represents an acquired clonal abnormality; FISH or higher-resolution study would define the breakpoints.
